repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: CURRENT source code and tests are the primary truth for zapret2-manager. Dynamic source evidence outranks stale documentation. docs/09-work, docs/99-archive, .superpowers and old plans/reports are historical evidence, not proof of current runtime behavior. Planned/incomplete features must be labelled as such.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: Z2M is the sole production runtime owner/coordinator. System Components are logically Zapret2 Engine and Z2K Core. Avatar is NOT a System Component; avatarDD/zapret-gui is a Strategy/resource catalog authority and UX donor where verified, and Avatar does NOT own Z2M runtime writes. Telegram Proxy is NOT a System Component; it is an optional product with its own install/update/status lifecycle. WARP / MASQUE is also an optional routing product, not mandatory Z2M foundation. Resource Center represents data/assets. Low-level Z2K Lua/blob/list assets may appear there, but this does not create a separate user product called Z2K Resources. Z2K Core is ONE logical system integration.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: Engine authority model: bol-van/zapret2 = base engine upstream; necronicle/zapret2-z2k:z2k-master = Z2K engine delta/reference; necronicle/z2k:z2k-enhanced = Z2K runtime/data upstream. Avatar authority: avatarDD/zapret-gui = Strategy/resource catalog + UX donor where verified. t0fox/zapret2-manager remains final runtime authority.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: Strategy is the permanent Apply authority. Scanner produces temporary evidence/candidates and does NOT own permanent Strategy Apply. Production nfqws2 ownership is exactly one persistent production instance, and production NFQUEUE is queue 300. DNS uses the existing dnsmasq ownership path; Z2M must not be described as creating a second resident DNS daemon. TG Proxy has exactly one selected provider process.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: User-owned resources must not be described as freely overwritable by upstream updates. Package release currently targets OpenWrt mediatek/filogic and must be described from CURRENT release config/Makefiles rather than old docs. The release package set is zapret2-manager, luci-app-zapret2-manager and zapret2-manager-full; Engine and Telegram Proxy are not hard bundled.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: Quartz remains controlled user-facing documentation: installation, first start, actual LuCI navigation, page behavior, statuses/buttons, basic configuration and supported platform/release information. DeepWiki is the primary technical/code documentation surface for architecture, subsystem internals, source relationships, data flows, RPC/backend contracts and release engineering. Preserve the internal docs/ vault for contracts, ADRs, work evidence, research, parity evidence and agent/internal material.

repo_notes.author: Z2M Maintainers
repo_notes.content: Generate explanatory prose primarily in Russian. Preserve source-code symbols, filenames, CLI commands, protocol names and established technical terms in their original form. Do not translate nfqws2, NFQUEUE, RPC, Lua, IPSet, hostlist, blob, Asset Registry, Strategy, Preview, Validate or Apply when translation would make source tracing harder.
